A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable versions of the same SageAttention3 work. Their main text, algorithms, equations, figures, tables, Appendices A.1–A.12, and checklist support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original kernel timings, generation-quality evaluations, fine-tuning and pretraining experiments, ablations, and five-seed results in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original timing, generation, training, ablation, and repeated-seed results in Section 5 and the appendices.

M1.justification: Algorithms 1–3 retain the same NVFP4 microscaling, two-level attention-map quantization, and INT8 training procedure that keeps dOV-transpose in FP16. Hardware optimizations and the transpose fusion in Appendix A.5 are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both retain Open-Sora prompts and COCO generation evaluations, GSM8K, DROP, MMLU, and HellaSwag fine-tuning, and FineWeb-Edu pretraining. No dataset, task, domain, or test scenario changes appear.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the kernel, generation-quality, training, and smoothing comparisons, including Figures 4–7 and Tables 2–8, 16, and 18. The newly cited TurboDiffusion is not evaluated as a baseline.

E3.justification: GPU settings, head dimensions, causal conditions, sequence-length sweeps, metrics, and training budgets are unchanged. Both retain the Appendix A.3 settings and the separate 1,000-step comparisons in Sections 5.3–5.4.

E4.justification: Both contain the same quantization-strategy ablations in Table 1, INT8-versus-FP8 analyses, accumulated-error and smoothing studies in Tables 15–16, and visual comparison examples. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendix A.4 and Tables 9–14 retain the same five seeds and mean/standard-deviation reporting. Figure 3 retains its mean ± 1 SD displays; no run-count or statistical-procedure changes appear.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted curves, rankings, and qualitative examples match throughout both PDFs. For example, Figure 4 retains 1038 TOPS, and Table 4(a) retains 164 seconds for SageAttention3 HunyuanVideo inference; appendix results also match.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, equations, and proofs are unchanged, including the two-level quantization analysis in Appendix A.10 and the backward-error assumptions and derivation in Appendix A.11. Citation renumbering does not alter the reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same novelty, acceleration, and fine-tuning claims, together with the qualification about slower pretraining convergence. The citation edits do not change contribution scope.

C2.justification: Explanations of quantization errors, INT8/FP4 complementarity, and partial cross-layer error cancellation are unchanged. Both retain the pretraining-convergence limitation and discussion of suboptimal Triton kernel performance.

D1.justification: The CUTLASS/CUDA and Triton implementation descriptions, hardware information, Appendix A.3 hyperparameters, Appendix A.5 fusion details, and code-access statement remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds TurboDiffusion, increasing the bibliography from 63 to 64 works. The introduction also cites the already-listed SageAttention and SageAttention2 for quantized inference and substitutes the existing efficient-attention survey for MInference in the opening motivation. Existing works remain cited, and novelty positioning is unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 swaps Jianfei Chen and Jun Zhu in the author order, changes 'Co-first authors' to 'co-first authors,' and updates citation ordering and numbering. Substantive prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–21 and Tables 1–18 retain their displays and placement. Citation edits cause limited paragraph and bibliography reflow, including moving the Twins reference from page 14 to page 13.

improvement.justification: The added TurboDiffusion citation and adjusted introductory references provide a small contextual update. Methods, empirical evidence, proofs, reproducibility information, and limitations remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. The bibliographic and editorial edits produce no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
